products.name: Tin Powders
products.description: Gas Atomised Tin Powder with spheroidal shape, excellent flowability, and consistent chemical purity for precision-driven applications.
products.detailedDescription:
P. P. Patel and Company manufactures Gas Atomised Tin Powder using advanced inert gas atomisation technology to deliver powders which are spheroidal in shape gives excellent flowability, and consistent chemical purity. The controlled atomisation process minimizes oxidation, ensuring low oxygen content and reliable performance in precision-driven applications.

Our gas atomised tin powders are engineered to meet the stringent requirements of sintered components, electronics, soldering, and specialty industrial applications, where uniform particle size, smooth surface finish, and predictable melting behavior are critical.

applications: Advanced joining processes and additive manufacturing processes

products.name: Bronze Powders
products.description: High-quality Bronze Powders with consistent chemical composition, particle size distribution, and excellent performance across diverse applications.
products.detailedDescription:
P. P. Patel and Company offers high-quality Bronze Powders manufactured under strict process control to ensure consistent chemical composition, particle size distribution, and excellent performance across diverse industrial applications.

Our bronze powders are produced using controlled atomization and blending techniques, resulting in powders with uniform morphology, good flowability, and optimized sintering characteristics. These properties make them suitable for both structural and functional applications.

types.name: Bronze Powder PB10 92-8
types.description: Bronze Powder PB10 is a diffusion-bonded bronze powder manufactured with a controlled composition of 92% Copper (Cu) and 8% Tin (Sn). The diffusion bonding process ensures excellent chemical homogeneity, uniform tin distribution, and stable sintering behaviour, making it highly suitable for powder metallurgy (PM) applications. Supplied in 100 mesh particle size, offering good flowability, compressibility, and dimensional consistency.

types.name: Bronze Powder PB9 91-9
types.description: PB9 Bronze Powder is a diffusion-bonded bronze powder manufactured with a controlled composition of 91% Copper (Cu) and 9% Tin (Sn). The diffusion bonding process ensures excellent chemical homogeneity, uniform tin distribution, and stable sintering behaviour, making it highly suitable for powder metallurgy (PM) applications. Supplied in 100 mesh particle size with good flowability and compressibility.

types.name: Bronze Powder PB7 90-10
types.description: Bronze Powder PB7 is available in both pre-alloyed and diffusion-bonded forms, with a controlled chemical composition of 90% Copper (Cu) and 10% Tin (Sn). These production routes ensure excellent alloy homogeneity, consistent sintering behaviour, and reliable mechanical performance. Supplied in a particle size range from 100 mesh to 325 mesh, offering flexibility for different applications.
characteristics: Available in pre-alloyed and diffusion-bonded grades
Wide particle size 100 mesh (<150 µm) to 325 mesh (<45 µm)

types.name: Bronze Powder 85-15
types.description: Bronze Powder 85-15 is offered in both pre-alloyed and diffusion-bonded grades, with a controlled chemical composition of 85% Copper (Cu) and 15% Tin (Sn). This higher tin content provides enhanced hardness, wear resistance, and bonding strength, making it particularly suitable for diamond tool applications. Typically supplied in 325 mesh particle size for fine particle distribution.

products.name: Copper Infiltrants
products.description: Specially engineered copper-based powders used to infiltrate porous sintered structures, enhancing density, strength, and mechanical integrity.
products.detailedDescription:
Copper Infiltrants supplied by P.P. Patel and Company are specially engineered copper-based powders used to infiltrate porous sintered structures, significantly enhancing density, strength, thermal conductivity, and mechanical integrity of the final component.

These infiltrants are manufactured with controlled chemistry, high purity, and optimized particle size distribution, ensuring uniform capillary flow and effective penetration into iron-, steel-, or bronze-based skeletons during the infiltration process.

technologies.name: Water Atomised Powders
technologies.description: Our Water Atomised Metal Powders are manufactured using a controlled high-pressure water atomisation process involves high-pressure water jets breaking molten metal into fine droplets that solidify rapidly, producing powders with irregular particle morphology, excellent compressibility, and consistent physical and chemical properties.
characteristics: Irregular particle shape for superior green strength and compatibility
Controlled particle size distribution to meet application-specific requirements
High Compressibility to achieve higher green and sintered densities at lower press loads
Stable chemical composition with low variation between batches
Good flowability and apparent density for consistent processing
Optimized surface characteristics suitable for sintering and secondary operations

technologies.name: Air and Gas Atomised Powders
technologies.description: Air atomisation uses compressed air as the atomising medium, producing powders with irregular to semi-spherical particle shapes. Gas Atomised Metal Powders are produced by disintegrating a stream of molten metal using high-velocity inert gas jets such as nitrogen or argon, resulting in powders with highly spherical particle morphology.
characteristics: Low oxygen content and high purity

technologies.name: Reduced Powders
technologies.description: Reduced Metal Powders are produced through a controlled solid-state chemical reduction of metal oxides, resulting in powders with a highly porous, irregular particle structure. This unique morphology provides excellent compressibility, green strength, and sintering performance.
characteristics: Highly irregular and porous particle morphology
Lower apparent density compared to atomised powders
Good sintering activity and inter-particle bonding

technologies.name: Electrolytic Process
technologies.description: Electrolytic Metal Powders are produced through a controlled electrochemical deposition process, resulting in powders with a highly dendritic, flake-like particle morphology and exceptionally high surface area. These characteristics provide excellent electrical conductivity, reactivity, and bonding behavior.

about.approach: We collaborate closely with customers—from requirement analysis and lab trials to pilot production and full-scale supply—ensuring the custom powder performs exactly as required in your production process.
